Klasse Zipper

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Zipper
public class Zipper extends Object

Utility class providing operations to combine and separate parallel lists.

Semantics:

  • Zip: combines two lists element-wise into a list of tuples.
  • Unzip: separates a list of tuples into two parallel lists.
  • Length handling: zip truncates to the shorter list length.

Contract: all inputs must not be null. List elements must not be null.

Examples: 

  var numbers = List.of(1, 2, 3);
  var letters = List.of("a", "b", "c", "d");

  var zipped = Zipper.zip(numbers, letters);
  // Result: [(1, "a"), (2, "b"), (3, "c")]
  // Note: "d" is ignored as numbers list is shorter

  var unzipped = Zipper.unzip(zipped);
  // Result: ([1, 2, 3], ["a", "b", "c"])

  • Methodendetails

    • zip

      public static <A,B> List<Tuple2<A,B>> zip(@NonNull List<A> as, @NonNull List<B> bs)

      Combines two lists element-wise into a list of Tuple2 pairs.

      The resulting list has the length of the shorter input list. Elements beyond the shorter list's length are ignored.

      Example: 

        var as = List.of(1, 2, 3);
  var bs = List.of("x", "y");
  var result = Zipper.zip(as, bs);
  // Result: [(1, "x"), (2, "y")]
      Typparameter:
      A - type of elements in the first list
      B - type of elements in the second list
      Parameter:
      as - the first list; must not be null
      bs - the second list; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a list of Tuple2 containing paired elements; never null
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if as or bs is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • unzip

      public static <A,B> Tuple2<List<A>,List<B>> unzip(@NonNull List<Tuple2<A,B>> tuples)

      Separates a list of Tuple2 pairs into two parallel lists.

      The first list contains all first components, the second list contains all second components. The order of elements is preserved.

      This operation is the inverse of zip(List, List).

      Example: 

        var tuples = List.of(
      Tuple2.tuple2(1, "x"),
      Tuple2.tuple2(2, "y"),
      Tuple2.tuple2(3, "z")
  );
  var result = Zipper.unzip(tuples);
  // Result: ([1, 2, 3], ["x", "y", "z"])
      Typparameter:
      A - type of the first component
      B - type of the second component
      Parameter:
      tuples - the list of tuples to separate; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Tuple2 containing two lists with separated components; never null
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if tuples is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0
